result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an industrial setting with basic but aging infrastructure. While sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the lack of traffic control and faded markings create a higher-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs or signals at this crossing, requiring pedestrians to judge gaps in traffic without assistance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features basic infrastructure including sidewalks, a signalized crossing, and curb ramps, but suffers from faded markings and poor pavement quality. The industrial/commercial land use and wide roadway geometry suggest a car-oriented environment with moderate crossing distances.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the roadway and crossing area can create trip hazards or cause vehicles to swerve.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded pavement to ensure a smooth and predictable surface for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection adjacent to a modern multi-story building. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic lights are present, the environment lacks visible pedestrian-specific safety features such as marked crosswalks or dedicated signals.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no visible painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, which fails to communicate pedestrian priority to drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large SUV in the foreground blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time remaining.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection on a one-way street with high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals. Sidewalks and curb ramps are present on both sides, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure, though the crosswalk paint shows signs of wear.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are significantly worn, which reduces their visibility to approaching motorists, especially in low-light or wet conditions.

hazards.name: Wide One-Way Roadway
hazards.description: The multi-lane one-way configuration can encourage higher vehicle speeds as there is no opposing traffic to provide natural speed friction.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway extending into the background

interventions.title: Refresh Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the high-visibility continental crosswalk to ensure maximum visibility for drivers and clearly define the pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection corners to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
